summary: Verified Robot Boogie audio loop fix in useRobotBoogieAudio.js. Both the static-code verification and the behavioral smoke test passed. LOOP_START=0.020, LOOP_END=10.984, src.loopStart/loopEnd set correctly (with defensive clamp), src.start(startTime, LOOP_START) skips head silence on first pass, and loopDurationRef.current is set to the trimmed loop length (LOOP_END - LOOP_START = 10.964s) rather than the raw ~11.024s buffer duration. Playwright smoke test: activated Chunk stem, let audio play ~25s (2+ loop cycles), then toggled off and back on — no console errors, no page errors, character glow + drum icon behavior working normally.
critical_code_review_comments: Defensive clamp Math.min(LOOP_END, buf.duration - 0.001) is good; consider also clamping LOOP_START to a max of buf.duration/2 for symmetry if a very short stem ever slips in.

loopDurationRef captured off the first available buffer — since LOOP_END/LOOP_START are constants this is fine, but a comment noting all stems must share the same trimmed window would help future maintenance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Robot Boogie loop-seam fix (iteration 19) verified via static-code check + 25s live smoke test with tap/untap/re-tap. Zero console errors. Web Audio loopStart/loopEnd are not observable via DOM so a code-level check is authoritative here.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — fix already applied by main agent and verified working.
